sources_considered.why: Primary research distinguishes improvements from scaling from improvements using grounding and fine-tuning.
Primary architecture and evaluation evidence for a potential narrow-task counterexample, but from an earlier period.
Contemporary evidence of an operational translation product; it does not provide an independent reliability evaluation or a complete architecture.
An augmented search-and-language-model system does not isolate whether deep learning alone is sufficient.

evidence_items.explanation: The research supports a narrower concern about scaling and factual reliability in dialogue. It neither establishes a general impossibility nor measures the February 2023 deployments.

GNMT supplies a concrete neural architecture and favorable translation evaluations, making narrow applications important counterevidence to an expansive reading. Its earlier evaluation does not establish the architecture and reliability of the product during the target period.

The contemporary announcement documents continued real-world translation use and product development. It does not independently establish reliability or isolate the contribution of deep learning from other components.

unresolved_gaps: No located evidence pairs a sufficiently complete architecture with an independent deployment evaluation for the target period.
The claim supplies no application boundary or acceptable error level.
Failures in driving and dialogue cannot establish insufficiency for all real-world applications.
The earlier translation results and contemporary product announcement do not establish a matched, independently verified counterexample under the stated criteria.
